errors.pickProduct: Pick an item from the search results.

actions.partialHint: You have {total}. Choosing fewer moves them into a separate entry first.
actions.splitHint: Cost is divided in proportion to the units.
actions.openSealedHint: Once the packs are opened the box counts as consumed; its value lives on in the pulls.
actions.extraFeeHint: Upcharges or return shipping. Added to the cost basis.
actions.feesHint: Platform fee and shipping you paid.
actions.editCostHint: Correct the total paid. Use grading or sell for later changes.
actions.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry and its history. Only for entries registered by mistake; this cannot be undone.

intro.edit: Correct what was recorded. The change is kept in the history.
intro.split: Move some units into their own entry, e.g. before selling or grading only some of them.
intro.grade-submit: The fee is added to the cost basis. The card stays raw until it comes back.
intro.sell: Partial sales split the lot automatically.
intro.condition: Only the fields you change are recorded.
intro.editProduct: Applies to every entry of this item.
